original.text: mano buddhy ahaṅkāra cittāni nāhaṃ na ca śrotrajihve na ca ghrāṇanetre / na ca vyomabhūmir na tejo na vāyuḥ cidānandarūpaḥ śivo 'haṃ śivo 'ham
original.edition: vulgate wording recalled from memory (verify against an edition)

paraphrase: I am not mind, intellect, ego or memory; not the ears, tongue, nose or eyes; not space, earth, fire or air; I am of the form of consciousness and bliss — I am Śiva, I am Śiva.
notes: Attributed to Śaṅkara (attribution traditional or disputed).
